condition: The multiedge_match helpers test edge-attribute sets for equality, so when two nodes are joined by several edges with different attribute values, subgraph monomorphism checks on MultiGraphs wrongly return False.
workaround: Pass a custom edge_match function that compares the attribute values as sets with values1 >= values2 (or as Counters, so repeated values are counted) instead of using categorical_multiedge_match.
